title: Static GK: Loktak Lake & Keibul Lamjao National Park (Manipur)
summary: Largest freshwater lake in Northeast India famous for floating phumdis.

blocks.content: Largest freshwater lake in Northeast India famous for floating phumdis.

items: Geographical Significance: Located in Moirang, Manipur; famous for phumdis (floating circular heterogeneous biomass masses).
Conservation Status: Keibul Lamjao National Park is the world's only floating national park (home to Sangai brow-antlered deer); designated Ramsar Site (1990) and Montreux Record (1993).

blocks.summary: Sangai Deer (Rucervus eldii eldii) is the state animal of Manipur.
